ui.smartthings.off.sub: Tap Scan nearby in the SmartThings app to connect
ui.smartthings.secret: A secret is recommended for SmartThings. Tap to open the service settings
ui.smartthings.machineid.sub: shown as the device model in the driver
ui.smartthings.cmdport.ok: The hub can send commands to this PC
ui.smartthings.cmdport.missing: No firewall rule, so the hub may not reach this PC. Check the log
ui.smartthings.cmdport.pending: The saved port %d applies after a service restart
ui.smartthings.responder.on: Always answers Scan nearby in the app
ui.smartthings.responder.off: No socket could be opened. Check the log
ui.smartthings.ssdpfw.missing: Restart the service to create it
ui.smartthings.search.hint: This PC and PC Control must be on when you tap Scan nearby. The time updates when a search arrives
ui.smartthings.wol.hint: The adapter the hub wakes this PC through. Automatic prefers the one the hub's requests arrive on
ui.smartthings.hubs.empty: Empty means any hub is allowed
ui.smartthings.hubs.hint: Only hubs on the list are answered. Remove them all to allow any hub
ui.smartthings.share.sub: Change it on the Sharing page
